articles.author: Ian King, Christina Kyriasoglou
articles.title: Nvidia CEO Huang Pitches Europe on All Industries Adopting AI - Bloomberg.com
articles.description: Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang pushed Europe to adopt artificial intelligence more quickly, striking a bullish note as some investors grow more skeptical about the sums being poured into the infrastructure underpinning the technology.
